title: Accounts Administrator
description:
You will have the daily responsibility of Sales and Purchase ledgers as well as general accounting support within the team.

Purchase ledger - dealing with queries, contacting suppliers regarding payment dates, receive and log invoices, matching invoices to purchase orders and goods received notes, supplier statement reconciliation.

Sales ledger - queries regarding invoices and payments, set up customer accounts, record payments, creidt control, sending statements.

General accounts - Company expenses, credit card transactions, setting up contracts, supporting the team as well as the Management Accountant and Finance Manager with any other accounting duties.

This is a fabulous opportunity working in a fast paced, friendly and supportive team.

PLEASE APPLY NOW AS INTERVIEWS ARE IMMEDIATE!

title: Accounts Assistant
company: Four Squared Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Are you a detail-oriented administrator with a passion for organisation and accuracy? We're recruiting for an Accounts Assistant Administrator to join a busy and supportive finance team within a well-established business.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop their finance and administration experience in a varied role where no two days are the same.

Working as part of a collaborative finance function, you'll be responsible for ensuring financial and administrative records are maintained accurately and efficiently, supporting the smooth running of day-to-day operations.
Key responsibilities include:
- Processing and validating invoices and financial documentation
- Maintaining accurate records and filing systems
- Investigating and resolving invoice and account queries
- Supporting supplier account reconciliations
- Processing credit notes and adjustments
- Assisting with month-end administration and reporting activities
- Monitoring financial information and highlighting discrepancies
- Responding to internal and external finance-related enquiries
- Managing incoming correspondence and documentation
- Providing general administrative support to the wider team

We're looking for someone who is organised, reliable, and enjoys working with numbers and data.

You will ideally have:
- GCSEs (or equivalent), including Maths and English
- Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel and Outlook
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- The ability to manage workload effectively and meet deadlines
- A proactive and positive approach to work
- Previous experience within an accounts, finance, or administration role
- Experience processing invoices or maintaining financial records
- Understanding of purchase ledger or accounts payable processes

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £26,000 per annum + Benefits
- On-site parking
- Company benefits package
- Ongoing training and development opportunities
- Friendly and supportive team environment

This role would suit someone with strong administrative skills who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and is looking to build a long-term career within a finance team.

Application Disclaimer: Due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to provide individual feedback to all applicants. If you have not heard from us within three weeks of submitting your application, please assume that your application has not been successful on this occasion.
Thank you for taking the time to apply.

title: Accounts Assistant - Sage Experienced
description:
An outstanding opportunity has arisen for a versatile and motivated Accounts Assistant to join a highly successful, fast-moving manufacturing and food production business located in the Smethwick. Operating within a structured and high-volume finance department, this position is ideal for a well-rounded transactional professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys taking ownership of a varied workload.

Reporting directly to the Accounts Manager, you will play a pivotal role in supporting the daily operations of the transactional finance function. Your day-to-day responsibilities will involve balancing both sides of the ledger, managing the accurate input and processing of high-volume supplier invoices, and matching delivery notes within a fast-moving supply chain. Additionally, you will take responsibility for daily cash allocation, raising sales invoices for corporate distribution clients, resolving supplier and customer ledger queries efficiently, and assisting with essential bank reconciliations to support the wider team during busy month-end periods.

Skills Required:
- A solid, proven track record operating as an Accounts Assistant or Transactional Finance Assistant, ideally within a manufacturing, distribution, or FMCG environment.
- Good foundational knowledge of both accounts payable and accounts receivable processes.
- Strong IT literacy, including intermediate Microsoft Excel skills and a high level of data entry accuracy and hands-on, practical experience utilising Sage accounting software to manage day-to-day ledger transactions.
- A proactive approach with the ability to communicate confidently across internal production, logistics, and finance teams.

What You Will Receive:
- A stable contract position offering a reliable weekly pay structure and holiday entitlement from day one.
- Free on-site parking alongside convenient access to local transport links.
- Exposure to a fast-paced, commercially successful sector that significantly enhances your interim CV.
- Genuine potential for contract extension or transition into permanent opportunities for the right candidate.

If you are a driven accounts professional looking for a rewarding interim challenge within a stable, forward-thinking industry, we would be delighted to hear from you. This is an excellent opportunity to make an immediate, tangible impact within a supportive finance division that truly values teamwork and individual commitment. To be considered for this immediate-start contract assignment, please submit your up-to-date CV today.

title: Accounts Receivable/Credit Control Administrator
company: MET Recruitment UK LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Accounts Receivable/Credit Control Administrator

Location: Dudley, West Midlands
Salary: Circa £30,000 depending on experience
Job Type: Permanent, Full-time
Working Pattern: Fully office-based

The Opportunity

MET Recruitment is recruiting for an experienced Accounts Receivable Administrator to join an established manufacturing business based in Dudley.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a strong background in accounts receivable who enjoys taking ownership of their work, understands the full sales ledger process and takes pride in maintaining accurate financial records.

We're particularly interested in candidates who have gained substantial, hands-on experience within an accounts receivable function and can demonstrate a thorough understanding of the processes involved, rather than simply processing transactions.

The business has recently implemented SAP, so we're looking for someone who is confident working with accounting systems, enjoys problem-solving and can adapt to new processes and the challenges that naturally come with a system implementation.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage day-to-day accounts receivable activities, ensuring transactions are processed accurately and efficiently.
- Raise and process sales invoices, ensuring accurate pricing, VAT treatment and customer information.
- Maintain customer accounts and ensure sales ledger records are accurate and up to date.
- Allocate customer receipts and investigate any discrepancies or unallocated payments.
- Perform customer account and trade debtor reconciliations.
- Monitor outstanding balances, prepare aged debtor reports and support credit control activities.
- Investigate and resolve invoice queries, payment discrepancies and customer account issues.
- Process credit notes, refunds and adjustments where required.
- Support month-end procedures, including reconciliations, revenue cut-off and reporting.
- Work closely with colleagues across Finance, Sales and Operations to resolve queries.
- Assist with identifying and resolving transactional issues as the recently implemented SAP system continues to bed in.
- Maintain accurate financial records and support internal controls and audit requirements.

About You

We're looking for someone who has developed a strong foundation in accounts receivable through substantial practical experience.

You'll ideally have:
- Proven experience within an accounts receivable or sales ledger position, with exposure to the full AR process.
- A stable employment background, demonstrating depth of experience and ownership of responsibilities.
- A sound understanding of double-entry bookkeeping and how sales ledger transactions impact the wider accounts.
- Strong reconciliation skills, with the ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies independently.
- Experience of cash allocation, invoicing, credit control and month-end processes.
- Confidence using accounting systems or ERP software; SAP experience would be advantageous.
- Good Excel skills and a methodical, accurate approach to your work.
- The ability to identify problems, investigate their causes and work towards practical solutions.
- Strong organisational skills and the confidence to manage competing priorities.
- A proactive, inquisitive approach and a genuine interest in understanding how accounting processes work.

Candidates who are currently studying towards AAT, or who have developed equivalent knowledge through practical experience, are particularly welcome.

Experience within a manufacturing or distribution environment would be beneficial but is not essential.

Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to join an established business where you'll play an important role within the finance function.

You'll have the chance to use your existing accounts receivable knowledge, contribute to the smooth running of the sales ledger and support the business as it continues to develop its financial systems and processes.

Salary: Circa £30,000 depending on experience

Please note: This is a fully on-site position based in Dudley, with no hybrid working arrangement.

title: Billing Administrator
company: Pertemps Black Country Perms - Agency - Contract
description:
We are looking to recruit a Tenant and Billing Administrator to support the day-to-day administration of property, tenant and billing processes. The role involves maintaining accurate records, processing lease and tenancy changes, raising charges and invoices, and ensuring all work is completed accurately and within agreed deadlines.
This position is a 9-month fixed term contract.
The main duties are:
- Maintain accurate property and tenant records on the Horizon system.
- Process lease renewals, assignments, new licences, rent reviews and data amendments.
- Set up and manage diary events to support billing and lease processes.
- Prepare and process documentation for new properties, leases, renewals and amendments.
- Assist with preparing residential leases and licences.
- Prepare accurate completion statements for internal and external contacts.
- Calculate and raise charges in line with lease agreements and billing deadlines.
- Generate invoices on annual, quarterly and monthly billing cycles.
- Process regular recharges, including utilities, car parking, Sunday trading and purchase ledger costs.
- Process insurance invoices and raise the relevant charges.
- Issue service charge budgets, reconciliations and supporting documents.
- Check rent rolls, charges and system records, highlighting any errors or discrepancies.
- Ensure all changes and billing activities follow company procedures and controls.
- Deal with queries from tenants and colleagues, escalating more complex issues when needed.
- Work closely with Property Management, Finance and other departments to resolve queries and outstanding matters.
- Follow established processes and suggest ways to improve efficiency.

Skills and Experience
- Good communication skills and the ability to work with people at all levels.
- Able to manage a varied workload and work to tight deadlines.
- Good attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- A positive and flexible approach with a willingness to learn.
- GCSEs (or equivalent) in English and Maths.
- Experience in Sales Ledger, Lease Management, Property Administration or Contract Management would be an advantage.

This is a great opportunity to work for a highly respectful company, they have so many benefits, including a subsidised canteen and a gym on site! 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.
For the right person there is a possibility this role can lead to a permanent position.

title: Credit Controller
company: Think Accountancy and Finance - Agency - Permanent
description:
Credit Controller
Location: Wolverhampton
Salary: 28000 - 35000
Contract: Permanent, Full-Time

About the Role

Our client is an established business operating within the food industry, supplying a diverse customer base with a range of quality food products

They are looking to recruit an experienced and proactive Credit Controller to join its finance team. The successful candidate will take responsibility for managing the sales ledger, collecting outstanding payments and maintaining strong relationships with customers to ensure effective cash flow management.

Working closely with the finance and sales teams, you will play an important role in maintaining accurate customer accounts, resolving payment queries and minimising overdue debt.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and maintain the sales ledger, ensuring customer accounts are accurate and up to date.
- Proactively chase outstanding payments by telephone and email.
- Monitor aged debt reports and prioritise overdue accounts.
- Allocate customer payments and reconcile accounts.
- Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies, payment queries and customer disputes.
- Establish and monitor customer credit limits and payment terms.
- Liaise with sales teams and customers to resolve outstanding issues.
- Produce regular aged debt and cash collection reports for management.
- Assist with month-end procedures and sales ledger reconciliations.
- Maintain accurate records of customer communications and collection activity.
- Identify potential credit risks and escalate concerns where appropriate.
- Support the wider finance team with additional accounting and administrative duties when required.

Skills and Experience Required
- Previous experience in a Credit Controller or Sales Ledger position.
- Strong understanding of credit control procedures and debt collection.
- Confident telephone manner with the ability to build positive customer relationships.
- Good negotiation and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Competent IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel and accounting software.
- Ability to work independently, prioritise workloads and meet deadlines.
- A professional but persistent approach to collecting outstanding payments.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a confident, organised and commercially aware individual who can balance effective debt collection with maintaining positive customer relationships.

Experience working within a food distribution, wholesale, manufacturing or FMCG environment would be advantageous, particularly where there are high volumes of customer transactions and invoice queries.

The successful candidate will be comfortable taking ownership of the credit control function, working to collection targets and contributing to the overall efficiency of the finance department.
